title: AP gets exclusive look at 'StarGate,' Ukraine's first aerial drone to evacuate wounded soldiers
key_facts: AP was granted exclusive access to a field demonstration of StarGate, a medical evacuation drone built by Ukrainian defence-tech company SkyFall.
StarGate was handed to a combat brigade this week for evaluation under front-line conditions.
It has a one-way range of 15 kilometres and, according to the company, can carry up to 150 kg, cruising at 65 km/h and reaching up to 105 km/h.
It uses Starlink and a proprietary L-Link system plus AI functions to keep control when satellite navigation is jammed; it is flown manually.
SkyFall says each system will cost at least $50,000 and it aims to produce up to 1,000 a month by the end of 2026.
The company has not provided data showing how reliably it can withstand damage in combat; the unit needs at least a month to judge results.
